title: Silas and the Border
author: Ines Iversen
blurb: Lior Ashgrove, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
